title: Dynamic 3D product aesthetic quality evaluation: integration and evaluation of multimodal physiological signals and machine learning methods
scope_note: 全文逐页规则筛查＋高相关证据页语义清点；证据链仅保留PDF原句定位，未使用旧表内容。
context_summary: The paper proposes a MACI framework to evaluate dynamic 3D product aesthetics using multimodal physiological signals and machine learning. It validates the method with 26 participants and reports high accuracy in aesthetic classification.
exclusion_facts: The paper does not collect subjective human evaluations directly. It uses physiological signals and machine learning to infer aesthetic judgments, not actual human subjective feedback.
